message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9‑inch round cake) | Notes |
|------------|----------------------------------------|-------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | White or brown; white gives a cleaner flavor |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Dutch‑process or natural – choose based on taste preference |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ tsp (7 g) | Works with acidic cocoa or buttermilk |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ tsp (7 g) | Adds lift if you’re not using buttermilk |
| Salt | 1 ½ tsp (8 g) | Enhances flavor |
| Eggs | 2 large | Room temperature for better emulsion |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Can substitute with buttermilk for extra tenderness |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) | Or melted butter for richer flavor |
| Vanilla extract | 2 tsp (10 ml) | Adds depth |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates cocoa and creates a moist crumb |
| Optional: 1–2 tbsp coffee | 1–2 tbsp (15–30 ml) | Intensifies chocolate flavor |

**Optional extras for a richer cake:**
- **Dark chocolate chips or chunks** (¼–½ cup) mixed into batter
- **Chocolate ganache or frosting** (cream cheese or buttercream)
- **Almond extract** (½ tsp) for a nutty undertone

**Tips:**
- Use a good quality cocoa powder; it makes a big difference.
- Make sure all dry ingredients are well sifted to avoid lumps.
- If you prefer a denser cake, reduce the amount of baking powder slightly.

Happy baking!
